name: Money Problems
overview: Scripture teaches that our attitude toward money must honor the Lord, recognizing Him as the source of all increase and blessing, as seen in Proverbs 3:9. Wealth is to be managed wisely and generously, with the righteous leaving an inheritance for future generations and showing compassion to the poor, which is regarded as lending to the Lord Himself (Proverbs 13:22; 19:17). The Bible also warns of the dangers of debt, portraying the borrower as a servant to the lender (Proverbs 22:7), and cautions against the insatiable love of riches, which ultimately leads to emptiness (Ecclesiastes 5:10). While money can provide for many needs (Ecclesiastes 10:19), true contentment and security come only from trusting God above material wealth.
